$comment: Files present in BOTH scripts/ and skills/template/scripts/ that may differ (distribute-what-we-use D6). Read by scripts/check-script-parity.mjs. Every entry needs a one-line reason, and an entry that is now identical or no longer in both trees fails the check as stale. Do not add an entry to silence a drift you did not intend: make the copies identical instead.

allowed.cross-review.prompt.md: This project's own review rules; the template ships fill-ins.
allowed.cross-review.security.prompt.md: This project's own security review paths and rules; the template ships fill-ins.
allowed.review-config.json: This project's own review globs and security paths; the template ships fill-in globs.
